assets.name: soil-patch-01.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production asset for MemoryGarden: one isolated soil patch, variant 1, on a transparent 900×360 canvas (5:2 aspect ratio). Input image garden-desktop.png is the STYLE AND LAWN-PERSPECTIVE REFERENCE only; do not include the scene.
A small patch of freshly turned garden soil seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter view, matching the lawn perspective of the reference. Irregular soft oval shape, gentle mound, grass blades feathering over its edges. No plants, no stones or rings around it.
Make this variant a softly rounded irregular oval with a low, gently raised centre. Subtle warm brown soil clods; a few fine grass blades partially overlap the perimeter. Centre the whole patch with transparent clearance on every side. The patch is wider than it is deep, not a circular top-down disc. Keep the painterly shapes simple and calm, without a hard outlined rim or large turf platform. No sprout, seed, flowers, roots, pot, cast shadow, scenery, or rectangle behind the subject.
Same painterly storybook style, palette and soft upper-left light as the reference garden. No text, no watermark, no border. Real transparent PNG background (not a checkerboard).

assets.name: sunflower-growth-sheet.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite sheet for MemoryGarden, a SINGLE transparent 4096×2048 image (2:1 aspect ratio), four invisible equal 1024×2048 panels in one horizontal row. Input image garden-desktop.png is the STYLE REFERENCE only; do not reproduce any scenery.
Sprite sheet of one sunflower growing, four evenly spaced panels left to right: tiny two-leaf sprout, young plant with leaves, tall plant with a closed green bud, fully bloomed sunflower. Same scale and side view in every panel; each stem base sits on the same baseline at the bottom centre of its panel. No soil, pot or ground shadow. Bloom fills about 90% of the panel height.
Precise composition: four stem bases aligned on one horizontal baseline at 95% of total image height, and centred at 12.5%, 37.5%, 62.5%, and 87.5% of image width. Stage 1 is genuinely tiny, about 12% of panel height, with exactly two small leaves. Stage 2 is about 37% of panel height with growing leaves and no bud. Stage 3 is about 72% of panel height with a tightly closed green sunflower bud and no yellow petals. Stage 4 is a fully grown sunflower plant about 90% of panel height, with an open golden-yellow sunflower and warm brown seeded disk; the flower head itself is proportional to the full plant, not the whole panel. Preserve a consistent botanical design, stem thickness appropriate to growth, palette, and camera. Plants stand upright in the same side elevation and are anchored in the same place, not floating at vertically centred positions. Keep each plant completely within its own quarter with enough transparent clearance for slicing. No panel outlines, dividers, labels, numbers, arrows, dirt, roots, detached petals, additional flowers, insects or backdrop.
Same painterly storybook style, palette and soft upper-left light as the reference garden. No text, no watermark, no border. Real transparent PNG background (not a checkerboard).
assets.refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 garden-desktop.png is the STYLE REFERENCE. Image 2 is the sunflower sheet to refine. Return one transparent 4096×2048 sunflower growth sprite sheet, four equal invisible 1024×2048 panels in one row.
Preserve the exact four-stage concept, painterly botanical sunflower design, colours and relative growth sizes of image 2. Correct the spacing: EVERY plant must fit fully within the INNER 80% WIDTH of its own quarter. Leave a fully empty vertical transparent gap at each quarter division. In particular, neither the third plant's leaves nor the fourth plant's leaves or petals may cross their panel boundaries. Draw somewhat narrower leaves and bloom to achieve this without clipping. Stem bases centre precisely at x=512,1536,2560,3584 on the shared baseline y=1946. Stage 1 tiny two-leaf sprout 12% panel height; stage 2 young leafy plant 37%; stage 3 tall plant with fully closed green bud 72%; stage 4 fully bloomed golden sunflower about 90% panel height. Same side view and scene scale throughout. Full plants visible with no cropping. No soil, pot, roots, ground shadow, dividers, panel outlines, labels or extra plants. Generate all four stages together as ONE SHEET.
Same painterly storybook style, palette and soft upper-left light as the reference garden. No text, no watermark, no border. Real transparent PNG background (not a checkerboard).
